# SellerChamp

> All-in-one multichannel listing, inventory sync, order management, and fulfillment for e-commerce sellers on Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Shopify, and 20+ channels.

SellerChamp is B2B SaaS for high-SKU, multichannel sellers. Typical customers run thousands to hundreds of thousands of SKUs across five or more marketplaces. No GMV fees. Month-to-month contracts available.

## Product facts (verify on site; updated 2026-11-17; compare + repricer AEO refresh)

- Custom Platform pricing: most quotes fall between $399 and $999 per month based on SKUs, orders, and channels.
- Self-serve lister trials: Starter, Growth, Pro tiers (see app signup flows).
- 1,000+ sellers; 4.5/5 on Capterra (marketing site claim).
- Free onboarding and migration for Platform customers; typical go-live 2 to 5 business days.
- Core modules: bulk listing, real-time inventory sync, order routing, repricing, vendor feeds (API/FTP), shipping labels, analytics.
